'''Phlut Design Systems''' was a [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]-based weapons development firm that took out a large capital investment loan from the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to fund a secret [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] program that it planned to sell to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. This resulted in the [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer combat droid]].

When PDS could not meet the terms of the draconian contract, IGBC took over the company, the IG lancer and 99 further plans, not manufactured by PDS, were sold to [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]]. Holowan only made a few of these models, including the [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]], [[IG-97 battle droid|IG-97]], and [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]], and took the designs one step further with the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]].
